text:
alex: Ferry 4 just listed as CANCELED on the terminal. 511 app is quiet tho. Heads up if you were planning to take it.

sam: Ugh, that was my plan. I just sprinted to the dock. Any shuttle options from the Embarcadero? :running_man:

jordan: BART > shuttle > chaos. 3 people already at the Muni stop. Thinking of biking instead, but it's drizzling. :umbrella:

maya: I can swing by the office with an extra umbrella if someone needs one — sitting on a pile of unused office merch 😂 :umbrella_on_ground:

alex: @maya legend. Also, if anyone wants a hot tea/coffee I'm on my way to the cafe — I'll bring a thermos to the dock at 8:40. First-come. :coffee:

sam: @alex can you grab 2? one for me and one for taylor. I owe you one.

weather-bot: Small Craft Advisory in effect until 10:00 AM. Expect choppy water and occasional cancellations. Link: https://weather.example/gov/alerts/SC2026

jordan: Thanks @weather-bot — that explains it. Heads up: if you see a big crowd at the shuttle, the 19th St route is usually faster this time of day.

maya: Also — if anyone wants a seat in my carpool from SoMa, ping me. I have room for 2. No judgment if you're wet.

alex: Quick poll — who wants coffee from the cafe? Reply with emoji: ☕ for americano, 🍵 for tea, 🧋 for iced (yes it's cold and sad).

sam: ☕

jordan: 🍵

maya: ☕ + umbrella (if one exists after I raid the merch closet)

taylor: 🧋 (brave)

alex: Cool — i'll be at the dock in 5 with 4 cups. If the ferry stays canceled we can form a soggy convoy to the office.

sam: Bring napkins. This is a mood.

jordan: Update: Muni 2 is free, hopping on. Good luck everyone — stay dry. :raised_hands:

alex: final: 2 coffees picked up. @sam @taylor get ready. @maya bringing umbrella stockpile to dock. :thumbsup:
